The shortcut approach streamlines workflow efficiency by reducing the steps needed to locate frequently-used workforce management documentation and data files.

t: Override the Workgroup Holiday Scheme at employee level within the Back Office
f: HOW TO - Override the Workgroup Holiday Scheme at employee level within the Back Office.docx
s: The Workgroup Override allows the user to override certain workgroup settings at an employee level. Currently the only override setting being utilised is the Holiday Scheme. It is the Holiday Scheme which calculates when an employee is allowed to book leave and this is derived from the workgroup as default.
ss: The Holiday Scheme override feature in CoreTime allows you to assign different holiday entitlements to individual employees within the same workgroup, rather than using the default workgroup-level Holiday Scheme for everyone. Use this guide when multiple employees share a workgroup but have different holiday terms and need separate leave booking rules. You'll navigate to CoreTime/CoreRoster > Pers Data > Person Maintenance > Work Group Override in the Back Office to add or manage these employee-level overrides. This is essential for ensuring accurate leave calculations when standard workgroup settings don't accommodate all employees' holiday arrangements.
sl: This How To Guide provides instructions for overriding the Holiday Scheme setting at the individual employee level within the Back Office system, addressing scenarios where multiple employees within the same workgroup have different holiday entitlements. The document outlines navigation through CoreTime/CoreRuster to Pers Data > Person Maintenance > Work Group Override, where users can view the current workgroup assignment in the top section and any existing overrides in the bottom section of the screen. The primary process covered involves adding an override by entering a personnel number in the Person field (or using the LOV button to search and select an employee) and then selecting Work Group Override from the Select Details dropdown menu. Once on the Work Group Override screen, users complete the Holiday Scheme field using the LOV to select an alternative Holiday Scheme that differs from the workgroup default, then click Save to apply the change. The guide is designed for Back Office administrators or HR personnel who need to manage holiday booking rules for employees whose leave entitlements differ from their assigned workgroup's standard settings. While the document structure indicates sections for requesting overrides and maintaining and tracking overrides, these processes are marked as to be determined and are not detailed in the current version of the guide.

t: Update Holiday Schemes in WFM v1.1
f: HOW TO - Update Holiday Schemes in WFM v1.1.docx
s: Closure dates listed against a Holiday scheme will automatically be recorded as absences against all employee appointments linked to the scheme. Holiday schemes are linked to employee appointments via the Balance assignment. Multiple Balances may be linked to the same holiday scheme.
ss: Holiday schemes in WFM (CoreTime/CoreRoster) automatically record closure dates as absences for all employees linked to the scheme, and must be updated each year when departments communicate their closure days. This guide covers how to add new closure dates to a holiday scheme, adjust floating day allocations in associated balances to maintain the 38-day university entitlement, and extend balance periods and calendars for future leave years. Open this document when you need to configure annual closure dates, ensure balance entitlements are accurate after closure day changes, or set up leave year periods for upcoming years. Note that as of March 2022, this process has no equivalent in the portal system and no planned migration date.
sl: This document is a how-to guide for HR Systems personnel detailing the procedures for updating holiday schemes in the WFM (Workforce Management) system version 1.1, specifically explaining how to record closure dates that will automatically populate as absences across all employee appointments linked to a holiday scheme. The document covers five main processes: introducing holiday schemes and their connection to employee balances, updating holiday schemes through the CoreTime/CoreRoster menu path (System Parameters > Holiday Schemes > Company Holiday Details), amending floating day allocations in associated balances to ensure total entitlements equal 38 days, extending balance periods when new leave years require configuration, and extending the balance calendar to support future leave year periods. Users navigate to specific screens such as Balances > Entitlements Per Balance and Balances > Calendars to enter or modify details including Holiday Date fields, Pay Codes (such as Code 160 for Public Holidays and Code 3701 for Fixed Closure Days), Days and Hours columns, and Period fields using the list of values (LOV). The document addresses the scenario where multiple balance versions exist for different employee groups (G1-5 support staff and G6+ academic-related staff) with different FTE hours (37.5 or 36.5), both requiring updates to reflect closure day changes, and includes specific formulas and calculations such as converting days to hours using 7.5 hours per day for 37.5 FTE balances and 7.3 for 36.5 FTE balances. As of March 2022, TAG has confirmed there is no portal equivalent for this process and no planned migration date, meaning this WFM system procedure remains the current standard for this task.

Enter a name for the scheme, following...
ss: Maintain and configure accrual and entitlement balance schemes in CoreTime/CoreRoster to track employee leave balances and long service entitlements. This guide walks you through creating Long Service Schemes, setting up Accrual Balances with parameters like affecting codes and accrual calendars, and configuring Entitlement Balances for holidays and length of service. Open this document when you need to establish or modify how leave accrues for employees, manage balance calculations based on hours worked, or set up long service leave increments that increase with tenure.
sl: This how-to guide provides comprehensive instructions for creating and maintaining accrual and entitlement balance schemes within the CoreTime/CoreRoster workforce management system, specifically addressing long service leave entitlements. The document guides users through creating Long Service Schemes via CoreTime/CoreRoster > System Parameters > Balances > Length of Service Increments, where administrators define service codes (up to 6 characters), scheme names, and increment stages that specify the "From Months," "To Months," and accrual percentage rates at which employees earn additional leave based on tenure. For Accrual Balances, users navigate to CoreTime/CoreRoster > System Parameters > Balances > Parameters to configure multiple sub-menus including Parameters (Display Format, When Entitlement Exceeded settings for personal vs. universal leave years), Affecting Codes (linking pay codes that are deducted from accrued balances), Advanced Parameters (enabling position history population from CoreHR and multi-appointment tracking), Accrual Codes, Days of the Week, and MSS Parameters to make balances visible in manager dashboards. The guide also covers configuration of the Accrual Calendar (CoreTime/CoreRoster > System Parameters > Balances > Accrual Calendar) where administrators set start/end dates and percentage accrual rates based on whether balances follow personal or universal leave year calendars, along with Balance Calendar configuration. This document is intended for WFM system administrators and HR configuration specialists who need to set up leave accrual schemes, configure balance parameters, and ensure proper integration with approved timesheets and employee position history data.

t: WFM_Transferring Timesheets to Payroll v0.1 (draft)
s: This process is followed by the Payroll Officer managing the casual payroll and should be completed once the casual payroll deadline has passed, so that departments have had the opportunity to resolve any unapproved timesheets and/or add claims on behalf of workers. This process will transfer the hours to CorePay (creating CorePay timesheets) and progress the CoreTime period to the next month. Before creating the timesheets, it is possible to review errors by retrieving...
ss: Payroll Officers use this process to transfer casual worker hours from CoreTime to CorePay once the payroll deadline has passed and departments have resolved unapproved timesheets. The transfer involves two stages: first running a test mode to review errors and warnings by work group, then switching to final mode to create the timesheets and progress CoreTime to the next month. Open this guide when you're ready to process monthly casual payroll and need step-by-step instructions for navigating the Generate Timesheets function, understanding error codes, and confirming control totals before the final transfer.
sl: This document provides a detailed step-by-step guide for Payroll Officers managing casual payroll at the University of Oxford to transfer hours from CoreTime to CorePay and advance the payroll period. The process involves two main parts: first, a test mode review in CoreTime > Period End > Generate Timesheets where users configure the Company field to "University of Oxford," Calendar Code to "A" (New Monthly), and select specific work groups or all work groups using the Work Group From and Work Group To fields to identify errors and warnings before final processing. The document explains five types of warnings that may appear during error review—including unapproved codes submitted but not approved by managers, unconfirmed hours approved but not signed off by HR Administrators, unconfirmed absence codes, and historical hours from previous periods—to help payroll staff understand whether departments have completed their sign-off obligations or if issues will delay payment to future periods. The second part requires switching the Mode field from Test to Final, which automatically selects all work groups, and after reviewing the Controls Totals window (showing total hours, breakdown by pay code, and worker headcount), clicking Create Timesheets to transfer the data to CorePay and progress the CoreTime period to the next month. This guide is specifically designed for Payroll Officers who need to complete the transfer process after the casual payroll deadline has passed and departments have resolved unapproved timesheets and claims.

t: Allowances
s:
# Summary: PeopleXD HR System "Allowances" Guide

This guide teaches users how to manage employee allowances within the People Management module of the PeopleXD HR system.

## What You'll Learn:

**Core Concepts:**
- The distinction between allowances managed in HR (permanent, recurring payments assigned to employee contracts) versus one-off payments handled in Payroll
- Different allowance types supported by the system
- How allowances interact with pay multipliers and annual allowance indicators

**Practical Skills:**
Users will learn how to perform the following allowance management tasks:
- **View allowances** — locate and access allowance records, understand different allowance statuses
- **Create allowances** — add new allowances to employee contracts, including how different allowance types have different setup screens, and how to create annualised allowances
- **Edit allowances** — modify existing allowance records
- **End allowances** — terminate allowances with end dates, and remove end dates if needed
- **Cancel and delete allowances** — remove allowance records from the system
- **Understand salary impacts** — recognize how changes to salary multipliers affect existing allowances

## Key Concept:

The guide emphasizes that People Management handles **permanent or recurring allowances** (like a regular night duty allowance of £25 per month that recalculates each payroll period), whereas one-off payments are processed separately in Payroll.

t: Assign Access
s:
# Summary of "Assign Access" Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage employee system access and security permissions directly from an employee's record in the PeopleXD HR system.

After reading this guide, users will understand how to:

1. **Navigate to the Assign Access screen** — by accessing the Command Centre widget, searching for an employee, opening their record, and selecting the Assign Access option from the Actions menu.

2. **Control different types of user access**, including:
   - **Menu Profiles** — restricting what system features, dashboards, screens, buttons, and widgets an employee can access
   - **Pay User Access** — granting access to payroll data based on Pay Group assignment, so payroll administrators can only view and process payrolls for their assigned groups
   - **Organisational Roles** — assigning managerial and approval responsibilities such as HR Salary Approver, Payroll Salary Approver, or Manager Dashboard access
   - **Recruitment Access** — controlling which departments' vacancy and applicant records an employee can view
   - **HR User Access, Expense, Training, Document, Team Area, Time Privileges, and Roster Privileges** — managing access to these additional system modules

The guide provides a structured overview of all available security categories that can be configured for each employee through a single Assign Access screen.

t: Contract Amendments
s:
# Contract Amendments Guide Summary

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage and modify employee contracts in the PeopleXD People Management system.

**Main topics covered:**

**Contract Amendments** — The guide explains when and how to amend existing employee contracts, distinguishing between two types:
- **Amendments with no salary impact** (such as changes to work group, cost centre, location, or hierarchy fields) — these can be updated directly on the contract without affecting payroll
- **Amendments with salary impact** (such as changes to hours or pay-related terms) — these require corresponding updates to the employee's salary record

**Change of Hours** — Specific guidance on how to process and record changes to an employee's contracted hours.

**Contract Timeline and History** — How to access and review the complete timeline of all amendments made to an employee's contract, including historical sequences.

**Contract Deletion** — Instructions for deleting contracts, including how to handle replacement contracts (contracts that replace existing ones) and additional contracts (supplementary contracts for the same employee).

**Amendment Deletion** — How to remove or undo a previously recorded amendment.

**Switching Posts** — Procedures for moving an employee to a different post, including relevant task lists and terms and conditions to be aware of.

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for navigating the People Management system to perform these contract management tasks.

t: Contract End Date Amendments
s:
# Summary: Contract End Date Amendments Guide

This guide teaches users how to modify or remove end dates that have been assigned to an employee's contract in the PeopleXD HR system, using the People Management module.

**What you'll learn to do:**

- **Change an employee's contract end date** — particularly for employees marked as leavers, by accessing their employee record, navigating to the Contracts tab, and using the "Amend End Date" function. The process involves selecting the correct contract (identifying ones with "Dormant" status and an existing end date), entering a new date in DD-Mon-YYYY format, and confirming the change.

- **Remove an end date** from a leaver's contract entirely.

- **Understand the impact of changes** — when you update a leaving date, the system shows you an overview screen that indicates which related data will be automatically updated and which items require manual review by you.

- **Handle automatic updates to related records** — specifically, the system automatically adjusts team area end dates to match the new contract end date (when they previously matched the old leaving date), removing the need for separate manual updates in most cases.

- **Identify mismatched dates** — the guide explains how the system flags situations where end dates don't align across different records, flagging these for your review since they won't be automatically corrected.

- **Manage user access expiry** — the guide covers how end dates interact with user access permissions in the system.

t: Contract Start Date Corrections
s:
# Summary: Contract Start Date Corrections Guide

This guide teaches users how to amend an employee's contract start date in the PeopleXD HR system and understand the consequences of making such changes.

**What you will learn:**

- **How to change a start date**: Step-by-step instructions for updating an employee's contract start date in the system

- **Which contracts can be updated**: Details on what types of contracts are eligible for start date corrections

- **What gets automatically updated**: When you change a start date, the guide explains which related employee and contract elements are automatically recalculated or adjusted, including:
  - Date first joined and rehire date
  - Substantive date
  - Salary
  - Allowances
  - Cost allocations
  - Pension information
  - Benefits in kind (BIK)
  - Deductions
  - Organisational roles
  - Shift types
  - Absences
  - Team areas
  - User access (JML)
  - Talent appraisals and objectives

- **Payroll implications**: How start date changes affect payroll processing in different scenarios—whether payroll hasn't been processed yet, is currently being processed, or has already been completed

- **System configuration**: How to set up user permissions so that appropriate staff members can amend contract start dates

In essence, this is a practical guide for HR administrators who need to correct employee start dates and need to understand the full ripple effects of such corrections across the HR system.

t: Contracts Key Concepts
s:
# Contracts Key Concepts Guide Summary

This guide introduces HR administrators to the fundamental concepts and terminology used in the PeopleXD People Management system when managing employee contracts.

**Key topics covered:**

- **Posts and Contracts relationship**: Explains that contracts are based on "posts" (also called post appointments) that are pre-configured in CoreHR. Posts serve as templates containing standard details like job title, location, and pay scale. When creating a new contract for any employee activity (new hire, replacement, additional contract, or rehire), administrators select an existing post, which the contract inherits. However, administrators can then customize individual contract details such as start date and working hours.

- **Accessing Posts**: Describes how the list of available posts displayed to users varies depending on two factors: the user's HR access permissions (which are linked to the organizational hierarchy) and the type of post configured in CoreHR. Access can be granted organization-wide or restricted to specific divisions or departments depending on the HR team structure.

- **Post Types**: Clarifies that posts are configured as either auto-authorised, auto-commenced, or non-auto. Auto posts are always searchable based on user permissions, while non-auto posts only appear if a post appointment has already been planned and authorised.

- **Contract FTE (Full-Time Equivalent)**: Notes that FTE values on contracts indicate whether an employee works full-time or part-time and can be entered manually by administrators or calculated automatically by CoreHR.

t: Devolved People Management
s:
# Summary of "Devolved People Management" Guide

This guide explains how to set up and use **devolved HR functions** in the PeopleXD system — allowing managers to handle certain people management tasks directly from their Manager Dashboard, rather than requiring HR department involvement.

## What users will learn:

**How managers can perform HR tasks:**
- Add new employees and onboard successful applicants
- Process employee transfers
- Create and manage employment contracts
- Amend contract terms (e.g., change of hours)
- View team information via the HR Dashboard and "New Starters" widget
- Track approvals that roll up to their manager

**How to set up manager access:**
- Configure which HR functions individual managers can access
- Set default post access (the organisational structure/positions a manager can manage)
- Override default access on a case-by-case basis
- Configure the "Default Post Details" parameter to control which employees appear in a manager's team view
- Customise menu options for different manager roles

## Key concept:

This is an **optional, customisable feature** that organisations can enable to distribute HR responsibilities to managers. Rather than centralising all HR tasks in a dedicated department, managers gain controlled access to perform specific people management activities for their own teams through the Manager Dashboard.

t: Diversity Configuration
s:
# Diversity Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to configure diversity-related fields in the PeopleXD HR system, specifically which information is displayed and how it can be accessed or edited.

## Key Learning Outcomes

After reading this guide, users will understand:

**What Diversity Config Does:**
- It controls which diversity-related fields appear on the "Background" and "Disability" screens within the Personnel Information section of the system
- It allows administrators to determine whether each field should be visible, hidden, read-only, or editable

**Where Configuration Applies:**
- The configuration settings are global and affect all users viewing employee diversity information through:
  - Employee Dashboard (employees viewing their own profile)
  - Manager Dashboard (managers viewing their team members' profiles)
- Note: These settings do NOT restrict HR administrators or devolved managers with HR responsibilities—they retain full access to all fields regardless of configuration

**Specific Sections That Can Be Configured:**
- Personal Details
- Diversity information
- Family Details
- Notes
- Disability Details (including general details and detailed notes sections)

**How to Access the Configuration:**
- The guide explains where to find the Diversity Config option on the HR Admin Setup Settings tab in the People Management dashboard

**Field Display Options:**
- Fields can be set to "View Only" (visible but not editable) or "Hide" (not displayed at all)

Essentially, this guide enables HR administrators to customize what diversity information is visible and editable for different user types in the system.

t: DocuSign Integration
s:
# DocuSign Integration Guide Summary

This user guide covers how to integrate DocuSign electronic signature functionality with the PeopleXD People Management HR system.

## What You'll Learn

**Core Functionality:**
- How to send documents (such as employment contracts) from PeopleXD to employees for review and electronic signing through DocuSign
- How employees receive and sign documents via DocuSign after being sent from the system

**Practical Setup and Usage:**
- How to access the document sending features within an HR Admin Employee Record
- How to send individual documents and document templates through PeopleXD
- How to configure templates for use with DocuSign
- Which PeopleXD data fields are available to use in DocuSign documents

**System Configuration:**
- How to set up the DocuSign integration in PeopleXD's Admin screen, including:
  - Account details configuration
  - Email default settings
  - Document parameter settings
  - Template management
  - Designated user account setup for sending envelopes
- How to access integration menu options and administrative controls

**Additional Features:**
- How to use Insight Reporting in relation to the DocuSign integration
- Where to find additional DocuSign resources

**Key Integration Detail:**
The guide explains that HR users don't need individual DocuSign accounts—all documents are sent from a single shared organization account, with users accessing DocuSign in a restricted mode through PeopleXD to initiate and send document envelopes.

t: Employee & Manager Requests
s:
# PeopleXD HR System: Employee & Manager Requests Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to work with the Employee and Manager Requests feature in the PeopleXD People Management system. After reading it, users will understand:

## What Requests Are
The guide explains the distinction between Employee Requests (submitted by employees) and Manager Requests (submitted by managers), and how these function within the HR system.

## Setting Up Request Forms
Users will learn how to configure and manage request forms, including:
- Creating new request forms from scratch
- Adding custom fields to forms to capture specific information
- Adjusting form settings to suit organizational needs
- Previewing forms before deployment
- Editing, duplicating, or deleting existing forms

## Controlling Access to Forms
The guide covers how to restrict who can access particular request forms using criteria groups, ensuring only appropriate employees or managers can submit specific types of requests.

## Workflow and Automation
Users will understand how requests flow through the system, including how workflows are triggered and how the system can integrate with an EMS (likely an Employee Management System) to automate processes.

## Managing Active Requests
The guide explains how to submit requests, track their status, receive and respond to notifications about pending approvals, and view the history of requests. It also covers an administrative view for HR staff to oversee all requests in the system.

## Additional Configuration
The guide touches on extra setup options, including managing manager access to employee information and using insight views for reporting.

t: Employee Bulk Updates
s:
# Employee Bulk Updates Guide — Summary

This guide teaches users how to use the **employee bulk update feature** in PeopleXD HR system to make large-scale changes to employee records efficiently, rather than updating records one at a time or requesting support from Optimisation Services.

## What you'll learn:

**Available Templates:**
- **Bulk End Allowances** — allows you to end multiple active allowances at once by providing personnel numbers, appointment IDs, allowance pay codes, and end dates. (Note: coordination with the Payroll team is recommended as changes automatically feed into PeopleXD Payroll)

- **Contract Templates** — the ability to create custom templates tailored to specific contract elements

**How to Use the Feature:**
- How to download templates and helper files from the Bulk Update Templates widget on the People Management dashboard
- How to prepare bulk update files for processing
- How to load files into the system, including using advanced settings
- How to identify and correct errors in bulk updates
- How to process records once validated
- How to manage uploaded files

**System Configuration:**
- How to configure menu options and dashboard settings to support bulk update operations

The guide is designed to enable HR users to perform large-scale employee record updates independently without needing specialist support.

t: Employee Files
s:
# Summary of the Employee Files User Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage the Files section within the PeopleXD HR system, which is used to store and organize documents related to employee records and their associated contracts.

**Key topics covered include:**

**Understanding the Files Feature:**
- How documents get linked to employee records (uploaded directly by HR administrators, generated automatically by the system, or uploaded by employees and managers)

- What document types are and their role in the system
- Security and administrator access options for files

- How to view existing files
- How to add files to employee records, including separate procedures for adding employee files and contract files
- How to add multiple files at once
- How to delete files
- Understanding files that are automatically generated by PeopleXD
- How employees can access and interact with their own files
- How managers can access employee files (both through a dedicated Files option and through the employee profile)

The guide is designed as a step-by-step reference for HR administrators who need to upload documents, manage access permissions, and maintain employee file records within the system.

t: Employee Files Configuration
s:
# Employee Files Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to set up and manage the Files feature in the PeopleXD HR system, specifically focusing on two main areas:

## Document Type Configuration
Users will learn how to create, edit, and manage document types — the categories used to classify and organize employee files. This includes:
- Accessing the Document Type management screen through the Template Configuration Centre
- Adding new document types by entering a code (up to 13 alphanumeric characters) and description
- Setting whether a document type is active (visible in dropdown menus throughout the system) or disabled (hidden from view)
- Configuring additional options for each document type, such as:
  - Whether documents are associated at the person level (tied to an employee) or contract level (tied to a specific employment contract)
  - Whether employees can view documents of that type through their own Employee Profile screen
- Editing and deleting existing document types

## Access Control and Permissions
Users will understand how to manage who can access employee files and documents across different user roles:
- **Administrators** — can have full access to all files or restricted access by specific document types
- **Employees** — can view certain documents assigned to them via the Employee Profile screen (if enabled for that document type)
- **Managers** — can access employee files through either the Files section or the Employee Profile option

In essence, this guide enables HR administrators to configure a secure, organized document management system within PeopleXD that controls what types of documents exist in the system and who can view them.

t: Employee Transfers
s:

- How to place a transfer request on hold for further consideration

**Administrative Actions:**
- How to cancel a transfer request
- How to complete a transfer once approved and generate the required new contract

**System Access Control:**
- How HR administrator access is restricted based on organisational units (company, department, division), which determines which employee records and transfers they can view and manage

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for both HR administrators initiating transfers and approvers handling transfer decisions within the system.

t: Employee's Salary Data Configuration
s:
# Summary: Employee's Salary Data Configuration Guide

This guide teaches HR and payroll administrators how to set up and manage the Current Salary screen in the PeopleXD People Management system. 

Specifically, users will learn how to:

**Access and Visibility:**
- Grant access to the Current Salary screen through menu options and user permissions
- Configure Pay User access levels and HR data access rights
- Enable the Current Salary screen option on employee records

**Salary Management:**
- View, amend, and delete employee salary information
- Use the timeline view to track salary changes over time
- Change employee pay groups
- Remove pending salary entries

**Allowances Administration:**
- View, add, edit, delete, and cancel employee allowances
- Manage allowance records independently from base salary

**Increment Tracking:**
- Access and review employee increment history
- Edit increment records

**Configuration Settings:**
- Set up salary amendment parameters, including requirements for reasons and comments when changes are made
- Configure default pay details for amendments
- Adjust display settings (such as hiding certain rate types like hourly, weekly, or daily rates)
- Control whether only approved salaries appear on amendment screens

The guide is designed for administrators managing payroll and compensation data within the PeopleXD system.

t: Ending a Contract
s:
# Summary: Ending a Contract User Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to end a single contract for an employee who has multiple active contracts in the PeopleXD system.

**Key learning outcomes:**

After reading this guide, users will understand:

- **The scope**: This process applies only to ending one contract while keeping the employee's other active contracts intact. It does not cover making an employee a leaver from the organisation entirely (which is covered separately).

- **What gets ended together**: When you end a contract, all related contract elements are also automatically ended, including salary, allowances, deductions, pension scheme assignments, and cost allocation assignments.

- **The step-by-step process**: Users will learn how to navigate to an employee's record, access their contracts, and select the specific contract to end.

- **Required information**: Users must enter a Leaving Date (mandatory) and can optionally add a Leaving Code, Leaving Destination, Location After Leaving, and comments.

- **Additional features available**: The guide shows how to access Notice Periods functionality (for recording resignation or employer notification dates), the Leaving Summary screen (which displays all contract elements being affected), and Appointment Details (a read-only view of organisational structure and contract information).

- **The outcome**: The contract will be marked as "Ended" status and remain visible to HR administrators for review, but will no longer be active.

t: GDPR
s:
# GDPR Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to manage GDPR compliance tasks within the PeopleXD HR system. After reading it, users will understand and be able to:

**Core GDPR Features:**
- Navigate and use the GDPR Request Centre, which is the central hub for managing all GDPR-related activities

**Right to Be Forgotten Requests:**
- Understand what the "Right to Be Forgotten" means under GDPR
- Create and process deletion requests for both employees and candidates
- Know what specific data gets deleted when these requests are processed
- Manage access permissions for these deletion requests

**Subject Access Requests:**
- Understand what a Subject Access Request is (a data subject's right to access their personal data)
- Create and submit new Subject Access Requests
- Download the requested data in different formats (CSV and JSON files)
- Access and review other related documents
- Generate insight reports to track Subject Access Requests

**Reporting and Monitoring:**
- Use the reporting features within the Insight tool to track and analyze GDPR activity
- View GDPR data organized by different perspectives: activity, categories, and request details
- Classify report sensitivity levels for data protection purposes

**Data Privacy:**
- Review and manage data privacy statements within the system

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for carrying out these compliance tasks to help organizations meet their GDPR obligations.

t: GDPR Configuration
s:
# GDPR Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches administrators how to set up and configure GDPR compliance features in the PeopleXD HR system (version 27 and above). After reading it, users will be able to:

**User Access Management:**
- Grant appropriate user access to GDPR features through the GDPR Menu Profile
- Control who can access the Request Centre where GDPR requests are handled
- Manage access to the GDPR Business Area in the Insight reporting tool
- Set up role-based access controls for employee records, including identifying the correct organizational roles, defining organizational groups, and assigning roles to employees

**System Configuration:**
- Configure GDPR control parameters, specifically setting statutory retention periods for data deletion and cleardown timelines for processing requests
- Customize the Data Privacy Statement that appears to users, including configurable elements like title messages, body text (multiple message sections), and links
- Publish the privacy statement and manage version control when updates are needed
- Handle multi-language considerations when using language packs and apply formatting using Markdown

**Security:**
- Restrict access to GDPR features by IP address to enhance security

The guide focuses on the administrative setup and configuration steps needed to enable GDPR functionality, rather than explaining how end users interact with the system once it's configured.

t: HR Admin Field options
s:
# Summary: HR Admin Field Options Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to configure and manage field display settings in the PeopleXD People Management system.

After reading this guide, users will understand and be able to:

**Display Options Configuration:**
- Control which fields appear on key HR screens including the New Hire wizard, Replace Contract wizard, Additional Contract wizard, Rehire wizard, End Person/End Contract screens, Key Information, and Contracts pages
- Set fields as either mandatory or optional (mandatory fields display with a red asterisk)
- Hide or show specific fields based on organizational requirements
- Configure display settings for employee records, contract records, salary information, leaver information, personnel numbers, key information, and continuous service data

**Combo Field Options Configuration:**
- Manage drop-down list options on CoreHR that are linked to Reference Data items
- Customize which options appear in contract-specific combo fields

**Key Practical Skills:**
- Access the HR Admin Field Options screen
- Update and change field display settings
- Understand which field options are available for different record types
- Perform any additional configuration needed to implement these settings

The guide provides detailed breakdowns of all available display options across different wizards and screens, as well as information about combo field configuration and any related system configuration requirements.

t: HR Changes
s:
# Summary of "HR Changes" User Guide

This guide teaches PeopleXD Talent system users how to manage and process HR changes through the HR Changes tab. Specifically, users will learn:

## Main Functionality
- How to review two types of HR events: **Leaver changes** (employees leaving the organisation) and **New HR Manager changes** (employees gaining a new manager due to role changes or restructuring)
- How to **approve or reject these changes** to ensure that related appraisals and objectives are properly updated

## Leaver Management
The guide explains how the system identifies and handles employees leaving:
- Leavers are flagged when they have an end date in the past and active appraisal or objective cycles
- Users learn the **eligibility criteria** for which appraisals and objectives are affected:
  - **Appraisals** are eligible if the end date falls within the appraisal cycle dates, or if the appraisal is incomplete after the cycle end date
  - **Objective cycles** are eligible if the end date falls within the objective cycle dates
  - Special rules apply for employees with historical end dates or end dates on the last day of the month
- Users understand what happens when a leaver change is approved: affected talent items are cancelled, previous managers lose visibility of the employee, and appraisals are updated accordingly

## New HR Manager Changes
The guide covers how to manage situations where employees receive new managers.

## Practical Operation
The guide provides instructions on how to **access the HR Changes screen** and **action changes for both individual employees and multiple employees at once**.

t: HR Employee Record
s:
# Summary: HR Employee Record Guide

This guide teaches users how to navigate and manage employee records within the PeopleXD HR system. After reading it, users will understand:

**Core Navigation:**
- How to access the Employee Record screen
- The layout and structure of the main Employee Record screen

**Employee Information Management:**
Users will learn how to view and manage various employee data across multiple tabs, including:
- Key employee information
- Employment contracts
- Manager assignments
- Current salary details, allowances, and increment history
- Pension contributions
- Deductions and cost allocations
- Custom/user-defined data fields
- Attached files and documents
- Probation details
- Contact information
- Notice periods
- Document signing via DocuSign
- Payroll forms
- Demobilisation dates (end of employment)
- Application details, task lists, and talent pool information

**Workforce Management Functions:**
Users will also learn how to manage ongoing workforce activities including:
- Leave and absence balances
- Work schedule changes
- Team area assignments
- Absence recording and management
- Employee and person-level settings
- Working Time Directive compliance

The guide provides a comprehensive overview of all the employee record features available in PeopleXD, enabling HR professionals to efficiently store, access, and update complete employee information in one centralised location.

t: Job Seekers Register
s:
# Job Seekers Register User Guide Summary

This guide teaches HR system users how to use the **Job Seekers Register** feature in PeopleXD's People Management system. After reading it, users will understand:

## What the Feature Does
The Job Seekers Register automatically identifies and tracks employees whose fixed-term contracts are ending soon, so the organisation can consider them for other open positions within the company before their employment ends. This helps with internal redeployment and ensures employees nearing the end of their funded positions have opportunities for continued employment.

## What Users Will Learn to Do

1. **Configure the system** — Set up two key configuration areas:
   - Define numeric parameters that control which employees qualify for the register based on their continuous service length and how soon their funding expires
   - Set up eligibility rules to determine who can be included

2. **Manage the register** — Add employees to the Job Seekers Register and understand how the system handles:
   - Funding expiry dates
   - Continuous service requirements
   - Automatic updates to the register

3. **Access reporting** — Use views and reports to monitor the Job Seekers Register data

The guide emphasises that the system works automatically based on configured rules around employees' funding expiry dates and service history, minimising manual administration while ensuring eligible employees are properly flagged for redeployment opportunities.

t: Key Information
s:
# Summary of the PeopleXD HR System "Key Information" Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to use the **Key Information section** of the Employee Profile within the PeopleXD People Management system.

**What you will learn:**

- **How to access the Key Information screen** — navigating from the Command Centre > Employees section, finding an employee record, and selecting the Key Information tab

- **How to manage and update employee personal details** across four main sections:

  1. **General section** — capturing and editing core employee information including:
     - Name fields (title, forename, surname, middle name, known as name, initials)
     - Social security numbers (PPS, NI, or other depending on system configuration)
     - Retirement date
     - Understanding which fields auto-populate from the New Hire/Rehire process and which require manual entry

  2. **Service Details section** — viewing and managing employee service history with the company, including the ability to override system-calculated continuous service dates

  3. **Work Permit section** — (mentioned in the contents but detailed content not shown in the extract)

  4. **Contract Info section** — (mentioned in the contents but detailed content not shown in the extract)

- **How to save changes** to employee records

- **Understanding field configuration** — recognizing that which fields appear and whether they're mandatory can be customized by the organization

t: Leavers
s:
# Leavers User Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to process an employee as a leaver in the PeopleXD HR system. After reading it, you'll be able to:

**Main Process:**
- Make an employee a leaver by accessing the employee record, clicking Actions, and selecting "Process As Leaver"
- Complete the required leaver information including the leaving date, leaving code (reason for leaving), leaving destination, and location after leaving
- Add optional comments about the end of employment

**Key Details You'll Learn:**

The guide explains the purpose of the leaver process: to make an employee's record dormant on the system from a specified leave date, end their salary record and all contract-related details as of that date, and enable Payroll to process them for a P45 (final tax document).

**Additional Actions:**
- Record notice periods by capturing either the employee's resignation date or the employer's notification date
- Review a "Leaving Summary" that shows all contract elements being ended, including cost allocations, allowances, deductions, annual leave balances, and pension scheme assignments
- Preview appointment and org structure details for the contract being ended (read-only view for review purposes)
- Save the leaver record

**Important Limitation:**
The guide clarifies when NOT to use this process — specifically, it should not be used when a contract is being replaced by another contract or when an employee has multiple active contracts and only one is ending. Alternative procedures exist for those situations.

t: Maintain the Organisational Hierarchy
s:
# Summary: Maintain the Organisational Hierarchy

This guide teaches users how to manage and update an organisation's structure within the PeopleXD HR system. 

After reading this guide, users will be able to:

- **Access the hierarchy management screen** through two routes: the Post Management widget on the People Management dashboard, or via the Data Centre widget
- **View and navigate the organisational structure** by expanding and collapsing different business units to see the full hierarchy, or using the "Expand All/Collapse All" function to display the entire structure at once
- **Search for specific business units** by name or code, with the system automatically displaying the full hierarchy path where that unit is located
- **Add new business units** to the hierarchy by selecting a parent business unit, searching for available child business units to add, and enabling them with a toggle before saving
- **Delete business units** from the hierarchy (specific deletion steps are referenced in the table of contents but not detailed in the provided text)
- **Edit existing hierarchies** to keep the organisational structure current and accurate

The guide focuses on the practical steps needed to maintain and modify how the organisation's departments and business units are structured and related to each other in the system.

t: Managing Post Profiles
s:
# Summary: Managing Post Profiles Guide

This guide teaches users how to manage post profiles within the PeopleXD HR system. After reading it, users will be able to:

**Core Tasks:**
- Access and navigate to post profiles in the system
- Search and filter post profiles to find specific records
- View comprehensive post profile details, including organisational structure, post details, cost allocations, pension schemes, full-time equivalent (FTE) information, linked appointments, and terms and conditions
- Create new post profiles from scratch
- Edit existing post profiles while understanding what restrictions or impacts apply to current appointments and contracts
- Deactivate posts by making them dormant and reactivate them when needed

**Financial and Administrative Management:**
- Add, edit, and delete cost centre allocations to posts
- Manage pension schemes assigned to posts—including adding new schemes, ending existing ones, and deleting schemes
- Handle important date considerations when making cost allocation changes

**Staffing and Capacity:**
- Update and transfer FTE (full-time equivalent) allocations across posts
- Manage user-defined fields (custom data fields) on post profiles by adding, editing, and deleting them

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for all these post profile management functions within the People Management module of PeopleXD.

t: Managing Salaries
s:
# Summary: Managing Salaries User Guide

This guide teaches users how to access, view, and manage employee salary records within the PeopleXD People Management HR system.

**Key topics covered include:**

- **Salary Record Fundamentals** — Understanding how salary records are created and structured. Users learn that salary records are linked to employee contracts or post appointments rather than directly to employee records, and that employees with multiple active contracts will have multiple corresponding salary records.

- **Viewing Salary Information** — How to locate and access an employee's salary data within the People Management system.

- **Understanding the Current Salary Screen** — A detailed breakdown of the salary screen interface, including how to interpret different sections such as:
  - Contract and Pay Group information
  - Current salary options and timelines
  - Allowances
  - Increment history

- **Handling Different Salary Scenarios** — How the salary screen appears and functions in various employment situations, including when contracts are appointed but not yet started, ended, future-ended, or when salary amendments are pending or future-dated.

- **Creating and Modifying Salaries** — Step-by-step instructions for creating salary amendments, including ad hoc adjustments and how to amend outstanding salary records.

- **Access Permissions** — Understanding the difference between HR access and salary access within the system.

After reading this guide, users will be able to navigate salary records, interpret salary information, and make necessary salary amendments in the system.

t: New Contract
s:
# Summary of "New Contract" User Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to create and manage new contracts for existing employees in the PeopleXD People Management system. 

**What you'll learn:**

The guide covers two main scenarios for awarding new contracts:

1. **Replacement Contracts** — when an employee's current contract ends and is immediately replaced with a new one (such as during a promotion). When you create a replacement contract, all associated items tied to the old contract automatically end, including cost allocations, pension assignments, salary, deductions, allowances, and annual leave.

2. **Additional Contracts** — when an employee receives a new contract that runs alongside their existing contract(s), without ending the current one.

**What you'll be able to do:**

After reading this guide, you'll be able to:
- Navigate to an employee's record and access their contracts
- Initiate the replacement contract process
- Select which contract to replace
- Begin configuring the new contract by selecting the appropriate organizational post
- Handle specific tasks like copying allowances and pension information from old contracts to new ones
- Configure replacement contracts with correct start and end dates (whether they're for past, present, or future scenarios)
- Set up required menu options for the new contract

The guide distinguishes this process from New Hire and Rehire procedures, which are covered separately.

t: New Hire contracts
s:
# Summary: New Hire Contracts User Guide

This guide teaches HR users how to set up new employees in the PeopleXD People Management system. After reading it, users will be able to:

**Main Setup Processes:**
- Set up new hires using three different post profile/appointment types: Auto-Authorised Post Profiles, Auto-Commenced Post Profiles, and Planned & Authorised Post Appointments
- Navigate the New Employee Wizard to search for and select the appropriate post for a new employee
- Check for duplicate employee records before creating a new hire entry
- Complete the authorization and commencement of appointments through the system

**Key Capabilities:**
- Search for posts using various criteria (post number, post title, or organizational hierarchy filters)
- Review posts that meet specific search criteria
- Complete the full workflow from initial setup through appointment commencement
- Copy existing new starter records to set up similar employees more efficiently

**Important Limitations:**
- The guide does not cover how to create or manage Post Profiles themselves (users are referred to a separate guide for that)
- There are restrictions on copying new starters for non-auto post types

Overall, this is a practical step-by-step manual for completing the initial onboarding process for new employees within the People Management system, covering the various pathways depending on the type of post being used.

t: Notice Periods
s:
# Summary: Notice Periods Guide

This guide teaches users how to configure and manage employee and employer notice periods within the PeopleXD HR system.

## What you'll learn:

**Understanding Notice Periods**
- Definition: A notice period is the length of time given to an employee before employment can be terminated, or the time an employee must give before leaving their role
- Purpose: To allow both employers and employees to plan for the end of the working relationship and minimize business disruption

**Configuration Methods**
The guide covers three main ways to set up and manage notice periods in PeopleXD:
1. Notice Period Rules Configuration
2. Terms & Conditions setup
3. Employee Record management

**System Access and Controls**
- Which menu options in PeopleXD control access to notice period functionality
- What web services are available for creating, deleting, getting, and updating notice period data
- How to configure notice period rules as new organizational defaults
- Access permissions for different user roles (view-only vs. update permissions)

**Operational Use**
- How notice periods are displayed and used during the employee leaving/leaver process
- How to maintain notice period information on individual employee records
- System configuration options, including whether notice periods display by default on the "Process as Leaver" screen

The guide is designed as a practical reference for HR administrators who need to set up, configure, and maintain notice period functionality in their PeopleXD system.

t: Offboarding Configuration
s:
# Offboarding Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches HR administrators and system configurators how to set up and configure the Employee Offboarding feature in the PeopleXD (CorePortal) HR system.

After reading this guide, users will be able to:

**Core Setup:**
- Enable the Employee Offboarding feature in the system
- Access and navigate the Offboarding Configuration widget

**Offboarding Checklists:**
- Create and maintain offboarding checklist items with different types
- Set up which checklist items appear for different employees or circumstances
- Restrict who can see or access specific checklist items

**Custom Content:**
- Add custom pages to the offboarding process with different page types
- Control access to custom pages through restrictions

**Required Documentation:**
- Configure policy documents and handbooks to be reviewed during offboarding
- Set up which documents employees must return or provide

**Reporting & Visibility:**
- Configure the Employee Offboarding dashboard (landing page) that employees and managers use
- Set up staff grouping and criteria groups for organizing offboarding tasks

**User Permissions:**
- Manage user access levels for three main user types (administrators, managers, and employees)
- Configure security profiles and web service modules to control who can perform what actions

The guide is designed for system administrators and HR configuration staff, and complements a separate user guide that covers how end users interact with the offboarding system.

t: Onboarding
s:
# PeopleXD Onboarding Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to use the PeopleXD HR system's onboarding module to manage and complete new employee onboarding processes.

**Key areas covered include:**

**Onboarding Basics**
- The distinction between employee onboarding (for new hires) and cross-boarding (for internal moves)
- How to access and navigate the Social Hub Dashboard, which serves as the central hub for onboarding activities

**Social Hub Dashboard Features**
- The information header that displays key employee details
- Checklists that track onboarding tasks, including what's outstanding and what's been completed
- Different onboarding scenarios and rules for checklist items
- Social activity features for team interaction
- Content pages for sharing information

**Available Pages and Content Types**
- System pages including New Starters listings, team area management, employee directory, quizzes, events, and FAQs
- Custom content pages that can include text, videos, maps, links, and images

**Notifications and Progress Tracking**
- How to receive and manage notification emails (weekly and daily summaries)
- Monitoring employee onboarding progress through the system

Overall, this guide enables HR professionals and managers to set up comprehensive onboarding workflows, track new employee progress through structured checklists, communicate information effectively, and ensure all onboarding tasks are completed systematically.

t: Onboarding Configuration
s:
# Summary of PeopleXD Onboarding Configuration Guide

This guide teaches users how to set up and configure the employee onboarding system within PeopleXD HR software. After reading it, users will be able to:

**Core Setup & Activation**
- Enable the Employee Onboarding feature in the system
- Understand the proper sequence for importing data before activation

**Checklist Management**
- Create onboarding checklists with multiple types of items, including:
  - Input fields for data collection
  - Custom pages for providing information
  - User-defined fields (UDFs)
  - Policy acknowledgments
  - Document requests and uploads
  - Employee document management
  - Survey items
- Edit, delete, and manage existing checklist items
- Re-release checklist items to employees
- Restrict access to specific checklist items as needed

**Custom Content Pages**
- Build custom pages within the onboarding workflow using different formats:
  - Link pages (directing to external resources)
  - Text pages (for written information)
  - Video pages (for multimedia content)
  - Map pages (for location information)
  - Image pages (for visual content)
- Maintain and manage custom pages

The guide provides a complete walkthrough of configuring a customized onboarding experience, enabling administrators to tailor the system to their organization's specific employee onboarding requirements and workflows.

t: Organisational Role Delegation
s:
# Summary: Organisational Role Delegation Guide

This guide teaches managers how to use the Organisational Role Delegation feature in the PeopleXD HR system to temporarily reassign their managerial responsibilities to colleagues.

**What you'll learn:**

- **Understanding delegation**: What organisational role (org role) delegation is and why it's useful — primarily for covering periods when a manager is unavailable (such as during leave or absence)

- **Eligibility and permissions**: Who is allowed to delegate roles, who can receive delegated roles, and which roles can and cannot be delegated (HR determines which roles are eligible for delegation)

- **What delegated managers can access**: What visibility and permissions a colleague receives when a role is delegated to them

- **How to delegate**: Step-by-step instructions for using the Delegation widget on the Manager Dashboard to:
  - Delegate an org role to a colleague
  - Choose which roles to delegate, to whom, and for how long
  - Update or delete existing delegations
  - Search for and report on delegations already in place

- **System configuration**: How HR administrators can set up the delegation feature, including which org roles should be available for delegation, configuring the widget and dashboard, and managing user access permissions

- **Important considerations**: Key points managers and administrators need to know about how the delegation process works and what happens when roles are delegated

t: Organisational Roles Configuration
s:
# Summary of "Organisational Roles Configuration" Guide

This guide teaches users how to set up and manage organisational roles in the PeopleXD HR system.

## What You'll Learn

**Core Configuration Skills:**
- How to create new organisational role types and edit existing ones
- How to deactivate organisational roles when they're no longer needed
- How to assign organisational roles to individual employees

**Understanding Organisational Roles:**
The guide explains that organisational roles are used to identify employees with specific responsibilities in the organisation. These roles enable employees to:
- Receive alerts and notifications relevant to their position
- Complete approvals for various processes (such as salary approvals)
- Receive and update work tasks

The system comes with three default roles (HR Salary Approver, Payroll Salary Approver, and Reports To), but is highly customizable so you can create additional roles tailored to your organisation's needs.

**Where Roles Are Used:**
The guide also provides an overview of different areas throughout PeopleXD where organisational roles are applied in practice — for example, sending notifications to specific role holders like IT Managers for new starters, or controlling which employee records managers can see in their team views.

Importantly, employees can hold multiple organisational roles simultaneously to allow them to engage in a variety of different tasks and responsibilities across the system.

t: Organisational Structure Configuration
s:
# Summary: Organisational Structure Configuration Guide

This guide teaches users how to set up and manage an organisational structure within the PeopleXD HR system. Here's what you'll learn to do:

## Core Setup Tasks
- **Access and create** organisational structures from the correct location in the system
- **Build the structure framework** by adding levels that define how your organisation is hierarchically arranged
- **Configure structure settings** including hierarchy indicators, initial values, hide indicators, and display modes
- **Activate** your completed organisational structure to make it operational

## Managing Existing Structures
- **Edit existing structures** by adding, removing, or reordering levels as your organisation evolves

## Reference Data Configuration
The guide covers how to define and configure the standard organisational components that form the building blocks of your structure:
- Company, Division, Management Unit, Department, Work Group, Cost Centre, and Location
- Custom User Fields (1–5) for organisation-specific needs

## Hierarchy Setup and Maintenance
- **Create and link hierarchies** that show reporting lines and organisational relationships
- **Build hierarchies** by adding a company/initial level and then adding subsequent levels beneath it
- **Manage hierarchy elements** including removing levels and handling shared hierarchy elements (where entities can belong to multiple parts of the structure)

## Display and Customisation
- **Control how the hierarchy displays** by setting default collapse/expand preferences and other display options

Overall, this guide enables HR administrators to design a complete organisational structure that accurately reflects their company's layout and reporting relationships within the PeopleXD system.

t: Payroll Instructional Forms
s:
# Payroll Instructional Forms Guide — Summary

This guide teaches HR users how to use the Payroll Instructional Forms feature in the PeopleXD system to communicate pay-affecting employee information directly to the Payroll team.

## What You'll Learn to Do:

**Core Skills:**
- Create custom payroll instruction forms tailored to your organization's needs
- Add new HR task list items designated as Payroll Instructional Forms
- Assign these tasks to specific organizational roles
- View and action tasks through the Pay Portal
- Generate reports on payroll instructional forms

**System Navigation:**
- Access and use the Pay Portal interface
- Locate and complete HR form tasks
- Review the history of instructional forms that have been submitted

**Form Configuration (for administrators):**
- Build custom forms from scratch
- Organize forms into logical sections
- Add individual fields to forms
- Control who can access specific forms
- Designate task owners responsible for completing forms

## What Payroll Instructional Forms Cover:

The guide explains that these forms are used to communicate various pay-affecting changes including: holiday balance adjustments, student loan deductions, tax code changes, overtime hours, bonuses and ad-hoc payments, pension changes, pay awards, employee joiners/movers/leavers, cost allocation changes, and manual payment adjustments.

Essentially, this is a guide for setting up and using an automated communication system between HR and Payroll to ensure employee pay records are updated accurately with all relevant information.

t: Payscale Configuration
s:
# Payscale Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to configure and manage pay scales in the PeopleXD HR system.

**What you'll learn:**

- **What pay scales are**: Pay scales (also called grades or positions) determine employee pay based on factors like job role, experience, length of service, and responsibility level.

- **The three components of a pay scale system**:
  - Pay Scales (the grade or position level an employee is assigned to)
  - Pay Scale Points (the different levels or steps within a pay scale)
  - Pay Scale Rates (the actual pay amount for each point on a scale)

**What you'll be able to do:**

- Navigate to where pay scales are configured in PeopleXD (under People Management > Payroll)
- Create and maintain pay scales
- Create and maintain pay scale points
- View and maintain pay scale rates (the actual pay values)
- Set up and manage pay scale restrictions (rules that control which combinations of scales, points, and rates are allowed)
- Turn pay scale restrictions on or off
- Understand user access permissions for pay scale configuration

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for each of these tasks, allowing HR administrators to set up a complete pay scale structure in the system.

t: Pension by Appointment
s:
# Summary: Pension by Appointment User Guide

This guide teaches HR users how to manage employee pension schemes using the "Pension by Appointment" approach in the PeopleXD CoreHR system — a method where pension schemes are linked to individual employee contracts rather than to employee records themselves.

The guide covers the following practical tasks:

**Setting up pension schemes:**
- How to add pension schemes to post profile records (job positions)
- How to end or delete post pension schemes

**Managing assignments:**
- How to assign a pension scheme to an employee's contract
- How to amend or change an existing pension scheme assignment
- How to end a pension scheme assignment (either when a contract ends or independently)
- How to delete a pension scheme assignment

**Key concept explained:**
The guide distinguishes between two different pension management approaches available in the system. "Pension by Appointment" allows organizations to assign different pension schemes to different contracts held by the same employee, and these assignments are independent of whether an employee changes or adds contracts. This contrasts with "Pension by Person," where pension is managed at the employee level in Payroll and is unaffected by contract changes.

The guide also notes the payslip impact of using the Pension by Appointment option, though specific details on this impact are not included in the extracted text provided.

t: People Management Dashboard
s:

This guide teaches users how to use the People Management Dashboard within the PeopleXD HR system (CorePortal). After reading it, users will be able to:

t: People Management Dashboard Configuration
s:
